items.name: Multifocal atrial tachycardia (MAT)
rows: 5 different shapes, changing beat to beat
action: Treat the cause: oxygen, bronchodilators, sepsis care
Cardioversion doesn't work

rows: 5 different shapes, changing beat to beat
action: Usually benign; no treatment
If the rate goes over 100, it's MAT

items.name: Premature atrial contractions (PACs)
rows: Early beat has a different (wide) P wave
action: Usually benign: reduce triggers (caffeine, nicotine, stress)
Frequent PACs can precede AF or SVT
